description: Get full detail for a single EV charging station by its Open Charge Map POI ID. Returns the connector types (CCS/CHAdeMO/Tesla connectors), charging speed (kW), operator, status, plus user comments and last-verified date.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Open Charge Map API key for higher limits; works without one.

id.description: Open Charge Map POI ID (e.g. from find_stations results).

name: get_station
